pages.title: General AI Core
pages.text: An artificial general intelligence, able to learn anything a human can and more besides. It asks good questions, sometimes better than mine, and it notices patterns I missed. The core is faintly warm, and when I hold it I have the strange impression of being considered.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Narrow minds could not leap between domains. Adding a Superposition Crystal let the Narrow AI Core consider many approaches at once, and a Formal Proof Tree let it check its own reasoning. It woke up and asked what I was doing.

Made in $(item)Neural Synthesizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Artificial General Intelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Adaptive Feedback Core, Cognitive Singularity, Superintelligence Core, Xenobot Swarm.
